text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Arima Kinen'. At the GⅠ race that 
brings the curtain down on the year."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Doryaaaaaaaaah! Since we've come this far, 
I'm gonna win 'em all!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Total unification under heaven!! From the 
northern reaches to the southern ends, 
everything belongs to meeee!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
No Reason conquers the Arima Kinen—!! With 
this, she achieves a double milestone for 
the year!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The “Autumn Senior Triple Crown”! 
Victories in the Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan 
Cup, and Arima Kinen. And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――A "Spring-Autumn Grand Prix" sweep! 
Victorious in both the Takarazuka Kinen 
and the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha-ha!! How's that, everyone?! 
I've swept the whole board!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! We've been had... The entire 
treasure is gone... Aaargh, damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I'll get you back. Next year――I will take 
it back."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if only for a single generation, No 
Reason undeniably ruled the realm. And 
then, with the new year—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nowa-hahaha! To celebrate the unification 
of the realm, let there be a festival, a 
grand festival, with music playing!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaa♪ No Reason♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's all this, my cute little fans? 
You may approach~♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on, Trainer, start 
scattering stuff too! Mochi, beans, 
shuriken, whatever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I won't go so far as to throw shuriken... 
but I toss bags filled with celebratory 
gifts to the fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Among the festival participants, there 
were also Umamusume to be seen."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-san, my sincerest 
congratulations to you on this occasion!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Lady Rob Roy! We may be rivals on the 
track, but today we call a truce!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Running with No Reason-san gave me a 
new goal to strive for.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What you accomplished this year—the Autumn 
Senior Triple Crown. I want to aim for 
that as well. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, has your soul been stirred? Splendid, 
then go forth and try! I know you can do 
it!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will etch it into memory, without 
fail. Just like you... A glorious page in 
the book of history!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by No Reason's great feat, new 
dreamers begin to appear. And then—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A tome called history, eh? Well... that 
feels a tad dramatic, don't you think?
choice_data_list: No, that's not true at all.

text_block_list.text: Right. I think so too.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You are—Lady Chrono Genesis?! Do you have 
business with me?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... May I speak with you? I was just 
so deeply moved...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who arrived was Chrono Genesis. 
She is an Umamusume who loves the racing 
history of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-san might not be conscious of 
history. However...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I believe the way you ran this year has 
been deeply etched into racing history.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
There was an extraordinary passion in her 
running. Such heat will surely... leave 
its mark in the hoofprints.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um... No Reason-san. Could you share your 
dream with me, as someone aiming to leave 
her name in history?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Sharing a dream, you say?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to aim for it too. For what you 
achieved this year—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—Conquering both the Spring and Autumn 
Grand Prix! An unforgettable memory for 
those who resigned themselves to history!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Toward that goal... I would appreciate it 
if you could offer some words of 
encouragement.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I see. Yeah, go on and give it a shot! If 
you've got lofty ambitions, you're sure to 
pull it off.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, quite right! In that case, the realm 
I have unified shall be divided into two 
and entrusted to you!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The territory of the Fall Senior Triple 
Crown belongs to Lady Rob Roy! The 
territory of the Spring-Autumn Grand Prix 
belongs to Lady Chrono!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume carries a dream she cannot 
yield. Devote yourself earnestly so that 
you may fulfill your true ambition.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! While I have no intention of 
losing as long as there's breath in my 
body...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
With you all around, the realm will remain 
peaceful even after I am gone! 
Nya-ha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, not only did No Reason unify the 
realm—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She shared that dream with those who would 
follow in her footsteps.
